1.t: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful

2.t: All praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds

4.t: Master of the Day of Judgment

5.t: You ˹alone˺ we worship and You ˹alone˺ we ask for help

6.t: Guide us along the Straight Path

7.t: the Path of those You have blessed—not those You are displeased with, or those who are astray
7.tr: Siraatal lazeena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril maghdoobi 'alaihim wa-lad daaalleen
